info.title: Synthient API
info.description:
Synthient API for IP enrichment, account management, and real-time data feeds.

## Authentication

All endpoints (except `/health`) require an API key passed in the `X-Api-Key` header.

## Feed Types

Each feed exposes two access patterns:
- **Stream** (`/stream`): Real-time NDJSON stream of live events. Connections stay open for up to 30 minutes; an empty NDJSON line is sent every ~15s as a transport-level keepalive that NDJSON parsers should skip.
- **Export** (`/export`): Pre-built parquet snapshots produced hourly and rolled up daily — list, download, and inspect metadata.

Each feed has its own dedicated section in the sidebar with full schema, scope, and cadence reference. Honeypot feeds are grouped under **Helios**.

## Timestamps

Every timestamp on the HTTP surface is encoded as Unix seconds (UTC, integer). The same instants on the gRPC surface are encoded as `google.protobuf.Timestamp` (RFC 3339 strings under protojson, structured `{seconds, nanos}` under proto3 binary). Both representations refer to the same instant — only the encoding differs.

## API Versioning

The HTTP base path `/api/v4` is the *HTTP surface revision*. The gRPC service is `synthient.v1.SynthientService`. The two version numbers are decoupled by design — they were not bumped in lockstep historically and are not now. A breaking change to the gRPC contract bumps the proto package (v2, v3, …); a breaking change to the HTTP surface bumps the path revision (`/api/v5`).

## gRPC API

All HTTP endpoints have equivalent gRPC methods. The public gRPC endpoint is `grpc.synthient.com:443` (TLS). Do not use `api.synthient.com` or port `50051` — the internal gRPC port is not exposed publicly.

Example:

```
grpcurl -H 'x-api-key: YOUR_KEY' grpc.synthient.com:443 list
```

See the `synthient.v1.SynthientService` protobuf service definition for the full gRPC API. Authentication uses the `x-api-key` gRPC metadata key. Rate-limit rejections additionally carry a `retry-after` metadata field mirroring the HTTP `Retry-After` header.

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Account info, quota, and the public health probe.

tags.name: Lookup
tags.description: Single-IP, batch-IP, and domain enrichment endpoints.

tags.name: Proxies
tags.description: Residential, datacenter, mobile, Tor, and VPN proxy IPs. One real-time stream and one parquet export.

tags.name: Anonymizers
tags.description: VPN, Tor, and relay-class anonymizer IP ranges. One real-time stream and one parquet export.

tags.name: Torrents
tags.description: DHT and tracker peer observations. One real-time stream and one parquet export.

tags.name: Helios
tags.description: Honeypot capture streams. Helios sensors record HTTP requests, TLS ClientHellos, and ADB shell commands from inbound traffic to our honeypot tunnels. Each protocol has its own real-time stream and parquet export.

tags.name: JA4T
tags.description: JA4T TCP-layer fingerprint sightings attributed to source IPs with provider, country, and ASN enrichment. One real-time stream and one parquet export.

get.description: Return the authenticated account's scopes and remaining quota.

401.description: Unauthorized

get.description:
List parquet export feeds for the **anonymizers** stream. Returns one page of daily and hourly snapshots, newest-first; pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` for the next page.

**Required scope:** `ANONYMIZERS_FEED`. Parquet snapshots land at `{stream}/latest/HH_{stream}.parquet` hourly and are rolled up daily into `{stream}/YYYY/MM/DD/{stream}.parquet` (00:30 UTC).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size. Defaults to 100; values above 500 are clamped.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination token returned in `next_cursor` of the previous response. Omit on the first page.

200.description: Page of export feeds. Includes `next_cursor` when more pages exist.

401.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid API key

get.description:
Download a single parquet snapshot for **anonymizers**. Returns a 307 redirect to a presigned R2 URL valid for 24 hours. 307 (not 301) because the URL is minted per request and expires — intermediaries must not cache it.

**Required scope:** `ANONYMIZERS_FEED`. **Columns:** `range_start`, `range_end`, `provider`, `type`, `country_code`, `asn`, `timestamp`

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Either a YYYY-MM-DD date for a daily rollup, or the literal string `latest` for the most recent hourly export.

307.description: Temporary redirect to a 24h presigned download URL on the CDN.

401.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid API key

404.description: No export exists for the requested date. If the date's daily rollup is still being assembled (roughly 00:00–01:30 UTC for the largest streams), the response carries a Retry-After header and a problem detail saying so — the individual hours remain downloadable at /export/{date}/{hour} in the meantime.

get.description:
Metadata for a single **anonymizers** parquet snapshot: SHA-256 checksum, byte size, row count, parquet schema (column names + types), and canonical date. No file body — call the matching `/export/{date}` endpoint to download.

**Required scope:** `ANONYMIZERS_FEED`.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Either a YYYY-MM-DD date for a daily rollup, or the literal string `latest` for the most recent hourly export.

401.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid API key

404.description: No export exists for the requested date. If the date's daily rollup is still being assembled (roughly 00:00–01:30 UTC for the largest streams), the response carries a Retry-After header and a problem detail saying so — the individual hours remain downloadable at /export/{date}/{hour} in the meantime.

get.summary: Download a anonymizers hourly parquet export
get.description:
Download a specific hourly parquet snapshot for **anonymizers** by date and hour. Returns a 307 redirect to a presigned R2 URL valid for 24 hours.

Hourly files are transient — shortly after 00:30 UTC they are rolled up into the daily export and the per-hour artifacts are deleted. Hours remain downloadable until their day's rollup completes (including yesterday's hours in the window right after midnight UTC); once rolled up, requests return 400 with a note pointing at `/export/{date}` for the daily rollup. The `latest` alias rolls forward each hour and tracks the most recent hourly.

**Required scope:** `ANONYMIZERS_FEED`. **Columns:** `range_start`, `range_end`, `provider`, `type`, `country_code`, `asn`, `timestamp`

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Either a YYYY-MM-DD date for a daily rollup, or the literal string `latest` for the most recent hourly export.

parameters.name: hour
parameters.description: Hour of day (UTC) — integer 0..23. Identifies the specific hourly snapshot for `{date}`.

307.description: Temporary redirect to a 24h presigned download URL on the CDN.

400.description: Bad date format, hour out of range (0..23), or the hour has already been rolled into the daily export (request /export/{date} instead)

401.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid API key

404.description: No hourly export exists for the requested hour

get.description:
Metadata for one hourly **anonymizers** parquet snapshot identified by date and hour. Same shape as the daily `/meta` response.

Hourly metadata is available while the hour's file exists — including yesterday's hours until their daily rollup completes. Once rolled up, request the daily `/export/{date}/meta` instead.

**Required scope:** `ANONYMIZERS_FEED`.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Either a YYYY-MM-DD date for a daily rollup, or the literal string `latest` for the most recent hourly export.

parameters.name: hour
parameters.description: Hour of day (UTC) — integer 0..23. Identifies the specific hourly snapshot for `{date}`.

400.description: Bad date format, hour out of range (0..23), or date is not the current UTC date

401.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid API key

404.description: No hourly export exists for the requested hour

get.summary: Stream anonymizer events in real time
get.description:
Real-time NDJSON stream of VPN, Tor, and relay-class anonymizer observations. Each event is an IP range (start/end) rather than an individual address — VPN providers issue blocks, not single IPs.

**Required scope:** `ANONYMIZERS_STREAM`. **Schema:** see `AnonymizerStreamEntry` under Components.

**Sample event:**
```
{"range_start":"198.51.100.0","range_end":"198.51.100.255","provider":"nordvpn","type":"commercial_vpn","timestamp":1714780800,"country_code":"NL","asn":60068}
```

200.description: NDJSON stream of anonymizers events. Each line is a complete JSON object. The connection stays open for up to 30 minutes.

401.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid API key

403.description: Forbidden — API key lacks the required scope for this feed

429.description: Too many concurrent streams from this client

503.description: Service unavailable — streaming backend is down

get.summary: Stream Helios honeypot ADB shell commands in real time
get.description:
Real-time NDJSON stream of Android Debug Bridge shell commands captured by Helios honeypot sensors. Each event is one command in a session, ordered by `sequential_id`. Use the `session` field to reconstruct the full attacker shell transcript.

**Required scope:** `HONEYPOT_ADB_STREAM`. **Schema:** see `HoneypotADBStreamEntry` under Components.

**Sample event:**
```
{"session":"sha256:abc…","sequential_id":3,"command":"d2dldCBodHRwOi8vMTAuMC4wLjEvbWlyYWk=","hash":"7c4a8d09ca3762af61e59520943dc26494f8941b"}
```

200.description: NDJSON stream of honeypot_adb events. Each line is a complete JSON object. The connection stays open for up to 30 minutes.

401.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid API key

403.description: Forbidden — API key lacks the required scope for this feed

429.description: Too many concurrent streams from this client

503.description: Service unavailable — streaming backend is down

get.summary: Stream Helios honeypot DNS queries in real time
get.description:
Real-time NDJSON stream of DNS queries directed at Helios honeypot tunnels. Each event records the queried domain, the destination port (53 for plain DNS, 853 for DoT, 5353 for mDNS), and the proxy/server/pool metadata of the inbound tunnel.

**Required scope:** `HONEYPOT_DNS_STREAM`. **Schema:** see `HoneypotDNSStreamEntry` under Components.

**Sample event:**
```
{"timestamp":1714780800,"tunnel_id":42,"domain":"command-and-control.example","port":53,"meta":{"proxy_ip":"203.0.113.10","server":"hp-eu-1","pool_id":"prod","provider":"luminati"}}
```

200.description: NDJSON stream of honeypot_dns events. Each line is a complete JSON object. The connection stays open for up to 30 minutes.

401.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid API key

403.description: Forbidden — API key lacks the required scope for this feed

429.description: Too many concurrent streams from this client

503.description: Service unavailable — streaming backend is down
